extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.

composition.summary: The call was compliant with the CMS contract year 2027 marketing rules. The TPMO disclaimer was delivered and compliant with the ordering:before-benefits basis. The Scope of Appointment was collected before the benefits discussion, and the appointment was scheduled.
composition.coaching_note: Agent: 'The Mutual of Omaha plan available in Lee County has a $40 monthly premium, a $480 drug deductible and a $2900 maximum out-of-pocket.' Agent: 'I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?' The agent should have asked the customer to sign the Scope of Appointment after delivering the benefits information to avoid any confusion.
